reasons: Summary accurately reflects source definitions of cellular automata as discrete computation models with grid-based cells, simultaneous fixed-rule updates, and neighborhood-dependent state transitions
Mechanisms correctly capture core update rule and neighborhood interaction concepts with appropriate qualifiers ("typically", "exceptions such as stochastic or asynchronous variants exist")
Historical progression from Ulam/von Neumann through Wolfram's classification to Conway's Game of Life and Rule 110 is factually supported by source text

Unknowns list appropriately identifies gaps not resolved in source (stochastic/asynchronous effects on classification, exact universality conditions, Class 4 emergence mechanisms, von Neumann constructor implementation details)
No unsupported mechanisms, copied passages, or invented execution details detected
